units: pixels (image coords, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale
summary: Indoor gym, side view of a wall of 8 tan padded panels above a dark base strip and a glossy wood floor. A dark red-brown basketball is thrown by an off-screen person (only hands visible at the left edge), flies left->right in an arc across the wall, bounces once on the floor at the right (frame 61) and leaves the right edge (frame 65). Afterwards a woman (cap, beige tank top, olive cargo trousers, white trainers with red soles, face blurred) walks in from the left and walks right parallel to the wall until the end. Hand-held camera drifts slowly (no cuts).

camera.motion: slow smooth drift (hand-held / gimbal): scene content moves left and up; no zoom (scale 1.000-1.002), roll up to 0.23 deg
camera.per_frame_file: tracks/camera_shift.csv (affine m00..m12 maps frame-0 coords -> frame-i coords)
camera.note: drift is ~0.2-0.5 px/frame horizontally and ~0.35 px/frame vertically, i.e. <1% of ball motion (~65 px/frame) and ~2% of walker motion (~20 px/frame). Tracks give both raw image coords and camera-compensated (_bg0) coords.

objects.motion_blur_px: along-motion extent exceeds across-motion by ~2-4 px at apex, ~10-15 px at release and before the bounce
